author: The Q
description:
After testing several kids smartwatches in real-life situations, the imoo Smartwatch X10 honestly felt much more focused on actual family communication and everyday usability.

The biggest difference for me was the 360° video calling system. Unlike standard fixed-camera video calls, the rotating dual-camera setup lets parents see much more of the child’s surroundings during calls, which feels much more natural and useful in real situations.

I also liked how detailed the location tracking is. The watch can show your child’s real-time location and even generate movement history routes over a selected period of time directly inside the app.

360° dual-camera video calls
High-precision GPS tracking
IP68 water resistance
Sports & heart rate monitoring
Photo sharing directly from the watch
Class Mode & parental controls
